body:
This is weird injector issue. Injection returns an empty object. 

Also noticed that the bug can also be triggered without optimization enabled but by enabling the prod mode with `enableProdMode()`. 

Edit: It looks like a circular Injection that doesn't throw properly. 
Edit2: The Circular DI error neither throw properly in devmode (it's silenced). 

Here is a minimal repro : https://github.com/JeanMeche/notify-scheduler-issue2 

Root cause for the error being caught/hidden: 

https://github.com/angular/angularfire/blob/35e0a9859299010488852b1826e4083abe56528f/src/zones.ts#L133-L140

@LanderBeeuwsaert The main issue in your case seems to be that you're pulling services in the `ErrorHandler` that trigger the circular dependency. 

Currently the `ErrorHandler` is instantiated eargerly with the App but this is likely to change in the future with #58984.
@JeanMeche ahhhhh ok thank you! Indeed I got it working by moving more services out of the constructor
